title: How Starting Before You Feel Ready Builds a Man Who Actually Finishes
caption:
You don't feel ready. You were never going to.

Motivation doesn't show up first and hand you permission to start. It shows up after you've already moved: after the first five minutes, the first ugly sentence, the first rep you didn't want to do.

Ecclesiastes got there before self-help did. "Whoever watches the wind will not plant; whoever looks at the clouds will not reap." There's no perfect wind coming. There's just today and the work in front of you.

Start before you're ready. That's the whole secret.
